description: This Java class 'BenchTestPane' defines a user interface panel with various buttons and controls for performing different engine bench tests such as fan, fuel pump, spark, injector, MIL (check engine), idle valve, and dizzy tests. It creates GUI components, sets their layout, and defines methods to instantiate specific test control panels with associated commands.

classes.name: BenchTestPane
classes.description: A Swing JPanel-based UI component that provides controls for various engine bench tests.

methods.name: BenchTestPane
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI components and layout.

methods.name: createMILTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for the MIL (check engine) test command.

methods.name: createIdleTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for the Idle Valve test command.

methods.name: createDizzyTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for the Dizzy (distributor) test command.

methods.name: createFanTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for the Radiator Fan test command.

methods.name: createFuelPumpTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for the Fuel Pump test command.

methods.name: createSparkTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for the Spark plug test with selectable indexes.

methods.name: createInjectorTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for the Injector test with selectable indexes.

methods.name: createIndexCombo
methods.description: Helper method to create a combo box with numbers 1 through 12 for selecting injector or spark indexes.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel content of the bench test UI.
